name: Teleportation Circle

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a 5-foot-radius circle on the ground within range

summary: Draw a circle that opens a portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
text: The portal stays open until the end of your next turn; anyone entering it appears at the destination circle. Casting it in the same spot every day for a year makes the circle permanent.
